comment: shell_store_receipt_vectors.json in this directory is a byte-for-byte copy of the authorization daemon's
committed Shell store-receipt vector (melusina-authzsign-component pkg/grainauth/testdata/, generated by
shell-store-receipt-vectors.mjs from the Shell's grain-gate.js). The daemon's own test
(pkg/grainauth/store_facts_test.go TestStoreStage_ShellEncoderVectorsAllow) drives each context through its
store stage: it Allows when the ReleaseEntry attests the context's app and release hash, and a one-bit change
to the release hash is refused as store:release-hash-mismatch (evalRelease, store_facts.go). Do not edit the
copy. To take a newer vector, copy the file from a newer commit on the daemon's main line, update every field
below from that commit, and replace git-objects/ with that commit's objects:
publish_admission_authz_vectors_test.go checks on every run, without an authz clone, that the copy's sha256
and git blob id are the ones recorded here and that the recorded commit holds that blob at sourcePath, then
admits and refuses each case with the Store's own publish admission and receipt signer.
